extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal breakdown voltage VZ = 6.8 V is paired with the tabulated IZT = 5 mA test current.
The BZT52C6V8 table row gives VZ = 6.46 V minimum, 6.80 V nominal, and 7.14 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 15 ohm at IZT; maximum ZZK = 80 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; admissible IZM = 5 mA.
The BZT52C6V8 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 2 microA at VR = 4.0 V and temperature-coefficient limits of 1.2 to 4.5 mV/degC at IZTC, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The six zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C6V8 trace labeled 6.8 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 3 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZT52C6V8 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.

Maximum ratings include PD = 350 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; the p. 3 pulsed characteristic plot separately shows a PD = 500 mW envelope and is preserved as the plot condition rather than substituted for the rating.
